_note: The grand campaign's counters, built by tools/grand/build_oob.py from Salerno '43's and Italy '43's counters and the research in tools/grand/research. Values of counters neither game has are by analogy with the two games' own.

campaign.name: Grand Campaign
campaign.description: From the Salerno landings to the Winter Line on both coasts, 9 September to 31 December 1943.

race.name: Race for Naples and Foggia
race.description: The landings, the battle for the beachhead and the drive on Naples and the Foggia airfields, 9 September to 10 October 1943.

winter.name: The Winter Line
winter.description: Both armies against the Bernhard and Gustav positions, from the Garigliano to the Sangro and Ortona, 1 November to 31 December 1943.
